headlines.title: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Enphase Energy
headlines.line: Multiple financial institutions, including BMO, Morgan Stanley, RBC, and Deutsche Bank, have revised their price targets for Enphase Energy following recent market developments.

headlines.title: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Visa Following Earnings Report
headlines.line: Following Visa's fourth-quarter earnings release, several financial institutions, including Oppenheimer and Morgan Stanley, updated their price targets for the company's stock.

headlines.title: Oracle Hosts 2026 Investor Day to Outline Strategic Growth
headlines.line: Oracle held its 2026 Investor Day, focusing on long-term value creation and updated financial targets.

headlines.title: Apple Stock Dips: What's Going On?
headlines.line: Apple shares are slipping Wednesday. The company unveiled its first touchscreen MacBook Pro, with earnings due next week.

headlines.title: Oracle CFO Says Capital Needs To Complete Current Investment Cycle Have Been Set At $20 Bln, Split Evenly Between Debt And Equity; Says Company May Begin Executing $20B Financing Plan As Early As Calendar 2026
Analyst Signals Favorable Earnings Setup for Mastercard After Visa's Results
headlines.line: JPMorgan sees a favorable earnings setup for Mastercard as Visa results signal strong spending and international payment growth.

American Electric Power CEO Sees Once-In-A-Generation Opportunity in Electricity Demand
headlines.line: AEP stock slips despite strong Q3 earnings, a $100 billion spending plan and booming electricity demand from AI data centers.

headlines.title: Visa Increases Quarterly Cash Dividend by 16%
headlines.line: Visa's board of directors approved a 16% increase in the company's quarterly cash dividend to $0.78 per share.

headlines.title: Apple Announces Redesigned MacBook Pro with Touchscreen and OLED Display
headlines.line: Apple has unveiled new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models featuring the company's first touchscreen interface and tandem OLED display technology.

headlines.title: Steve Eisman Says Anthropic Left Q3 Figures Out of IPO Filing on Purpose: 'Very Intentional'
headlines.line: Steve Eisman says Anthropic intentionally omitted third-quarter figures from its IPO filing as revenue growth and AI efficiency slowed.

headlines.title: Alphabet’s $514 Billion Google Cloud Backlog, AI Spending Put 2027 Growth in Focus, Says Analyst
headlines.line: Alphabet stock rises as Wall Street forecasts a 90% jump in Google Cloud revenue to $29.1B and a massive $514B backlog ramp ahead of Q3 earnings.

headlines.title: Royalties Inc. Announces Participation in Munich Mining Conference
headlines.line: Royalties Inc. announced that its Chairman and CEO, Tim Gallagher, will present at the upcoming Munich Mining Conference on November 6-7, 2026.

headlines.title: Boeing Releases 2026 World Air Cargo Forecast
headlines.line: Boeing projects that global air cargo traffic will double over the next 20 years, requiring nearly 3,000 new and converted freighters.

summary:
**Market Summary: Session of 2026-10-28**

U.S. equities finished mixed. SPY rose 0.16% and QQQ gained 0.27%, while IWM fell 0.13% and DIA rose 0.08%. Technology led sector gains (XLK +0.56%), and energy (XLE +0.68%) also advanced. Utilities (-0.79%), real estate (-1.13%), and communication services (-0.56%) lagged. Long Treasuries (TLT) fell 0.98%, gold (GLD) slipped 0.27%, and oil (USO) rose 2.63%. The dollar index (UUP) eased 0.25%.

Top eligible gainers were KIDS (+31.6%) and AXGN (+31.2%). The largest decline was BCAX (-45.2%). The most active names by volume included SPCX, NU, SOFI, and INTC.

Oracle led news coverage. Its Investor Day outlined free cash flow targets above $30 billion for FY29 and a FY30 revenue outlook of $225 billion or more. Visa reported fourth-quarter results and raised its quarterly dividend 16% to $0.78. Apple unveiled redesigned MacBook Pro models with touchscreen and OLED displays. Several firms adjusted price targets for Enphase and Visa.
